journey.name: Suka Shawarma Customer App End-to-End User Journey
journey.description: Comprehensive end-to-end journey testing the Suka Shawarma customer mobile application on Android: promo popup handling, home screen discovery, outlet selection modal, menu catalog browsing, product customization with toppings and notes, cart verification, checkout summary, order tracking history, and user profile management.

actions.action: Verify that the app is open and on the Home screen or Promo dialog
Tap "Nanti Saja" or close button if Promo dialog is visible
Verify that the Home screen displays the brand header "SUKA SHAWARMA" and tagline "Otentik • Panggang • Gurih"
Verify that the outlet status banner displays "Buka" and active outlet name
Verify that Best Seller menu items are displayed on Home screen

Verify that the outlet picker screen is displayed with "Pilih Outlet"
Tap the close button "Tutup" to return to Home
